Pivot a wide species matrix to mvgam long-format

Source: R/data_helpers.R
pivot_species_matrix.Rd

Convert the wide [J sites, N species] response matrix used by Hmsc (and any single-visit JSDM workflow) into the long-format (series, time, y, ...) layout that mvgam() / jsdgam() with a simplex (diri(), multi(), categ()), continuous-response (mvn(), mvt()), or bernoulli / binomial / poisson family expects.

Usage

pivot_species_matrix(
  Y,
  site_covs = NULL,
  traits = NULL,
  site_id_name = "time",
  series_name = "series",
  values_to = "y"
)

Arguments

Y

A [J_sites, N_species] matrix or data.frame. Column names become the series factor levels; missing column names default to sp1, sp2, ....

site_covs

Optional data.frame of site-level covariates with nrow == J_sites. The Hmsc XData slot maps here.

traits

Optional data.frame of per-species traits with nrow == N_species. Broadcast across sites. The Hmsc TrData slot maps here.

site_id_name

Name of the site identifier in the output. Defaults to "time".

series_name

Name of the species column. Defaults to "series".

values_to

Name of the response column. Defaults to "y".

Value

A long-format data.frame with J * N rows, each carrying series, time, y, site covariates broadcast across species and species traits broadcast across sites.

See also
